name: WA Parcel Appellation Ontology
abstract: Classes for the Landgate parcel identifier forms (Lot on Plan, Crown Allotment, Miscellaneous Tenure), as specialisations of the compound name model.

examples.title: Lot on Plan appellation
examples.content:
A Lot on Plan appellation is a compound name. Its parts are validated by the compound name rules, and the
part labels must appear in the appellation label.
